items.stem: Which TWO are warning signs that an incentive plan may drive the wrong behaviour? (Select TWO)

options.text: It rewards a single metric people can game
options.rationale: Correct: a lone gameable metric invites shortcuts that hurt other goals.

options.text: It ignores quality while rewarding volume
options.rationale: Correct: rewarding volume alone can push people to sacrifice quality.

options.text: It is explained clearly to participants
options.rationale: Clarity is a strength of a plan, not a warning sign.

options.text: It is capped at an affordable amount
options.rationale: A sensible cap protects the budget; it is not a red flag.
